CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

6. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

10. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
